mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_NO, MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_PWD, MEMBER_NAME, PHONE, EMAIL, ADDRESS, INTEREST, ENROLL_DATE, MODIFY_DATE, STATUS FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND MEMBER_PWD = #{memberPwd} AND STATUS ='Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( MEMBER_NO, MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_PWD, MEMBER_NAME, PHONE, EMAIL, ADDRESS, INTEREST ) VALUES( SEQ_MNO.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{memberPwd}, #{memberName}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{address}, #{interest} )
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET PHONE = #{phone}, EMAIL = #{email}, ADDRESS = #{address}, INTEREST =#{interest}, MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND MEMBER_NAME = #{memberName} AND STATUS = 'Y'
